corrections.why: The Georgia towers list spells the county Putnam. The NHLR page spells it Putman, which looks like a typo, so the record should use Putnam.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: NHLR spells the county Putman; the Georgia list spells it Putnam. The story uses Putnam.
NHLR gives 662 ft (202 m); the Georgia list gives 687 ft. The story reports both; the record keeps the NHLR figure, which matches the brief.

notes_for_editor: Thin record: NHLR page and one table-style list. The brief's county 'Putman' is corrected to Putnam (list and standard spelling). Elevation disagreement noted (NHLR 662 ft vs list 687 ft). The Forest Lookouts pages for Mathis (easternuslookouts.weebly.com/mathis.html) return 404, so no second history source was found. Two web searches. No staffing, fire, closure or access sources found; visit status unknown and the access level is left unset. Oconee National Forest pages were not checked.
